violations.text: The non-food-contact surfaces of the cookline equipment (side surfaces between equipment) were observed to have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. Equipment is to be cleaned and maintained clean precluding the buildup of soil and debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The following areas of the physical facilities were observed to be in need of adjustment/repair... - Several floor tiles in the kitchen area were observed to be cracked/chipped/stained/missing and in need of replacement - The painted ceiling above the dishwashing area was observed to be cracking/chipping and in need of resealing - The light fixture covers to the lights nearest the dish areas are cracked and in need of replacement The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2026
The hand-washing sink in the bar was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were provided by staff at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

Containers of raw chicken and raw shrimp were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food items were rearranged for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

The food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with a buildup of residue. PIC turned off the ice machine and began melting of ice at the time of inspection. Per the PIC, unit is to be properly cleaned and sanitized prior to reuse. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

The following food items were observed in need of adjustment to cooling strategies: - Noodles cooked prior to inspection were observed cooling while covered and densely packed in a plastic container in the walk-in cooler. PIC informed for proper cooling, food item is to be spread out in larger or multiple shallow containers - Water chestnuts, garlic, and baby corn recently stocked from dry storage were observed in the large prep unit at 50-56 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC made aware to ensure proper cooling of item after opening, food items to be placed in the walk-in cooler for rapid cooling and not directly onto the cookline refrigeration. Food items moved to the walk-in cooler at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

Open dry ingredient bag(s) was observed stored in the basement without cover/protection. Dry ingredient bags are to be covered and protected from possible contamination between uses. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - kitchen hand sink and faucet - cookline equipment side surfaces - cookline shelving - refrigeration/freezer door handle surfaces - the small table near the hand sink - dry ingredient dispenser containers Equipment is to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean and preclude the buildup of soil and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

The floor and walls under and behind equipment in the following areas was observed in need to have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: - cookline - dish washer - kitchen hand sink area - bar area The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

The following areas of the physical facilities were observed to be in need of adjustment/repair...- Floor tiles in the kitchen area were observed to be cracked/chipped and in need of replacement- The painted ceiling above the dishwashing area was observed to be cracking/chipping and in need of resealing- The light fixture cover to the light nearest the dishwasher is cracked and in need of replacementThe physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2027
